Name: Grandpa's Premium Shed
Author: mdurham6890
Description:
[size=5][b]Grandpa's Premium Shed[/b][/size]
[size=3]A premium endgame building for Robin's shop that combines a spacious workshop with a fully automated greenhouse.[/size]
[line]
[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Main Floor Workshop[/b] — A large interior space perfect for kegs, chests, and other equipment.
[*][b]15% Faster Kegs[/b] — All kegs placed on the main floor process items 15% faster than normal.
[*][b]Greenhouse Upstairs[/b] — A full greenhouse on the second floor where you can plant and grow crops year-round.
[*][b]25% Faster Crop Growth[/b] — Crops planted in the greenhouse grow 25% faster than normal, including regrowable crops.
[*][b]Auto-Watering[/b] — All crops in the greenhouse are automatically watered every morning. No sprinklers needed.
[*][b]Full Automation Pipeline[/b] — Each morning, the shed automatically:
[list]
  [*]Collects finished products from kegs
  [*]Harvests mature crops from the greenhouse
  [*]Loads harvested crops into empty kegs
  [*]Sends wine/juice to empty casks in your Winery (if you have one on the same farm)
  [*]Collects iridium-quality items from finished casks
  [*]Stores everything in chests on the main floor
[/list][/list]
[line]
[size=4][b]Winery Integration (Optional)[/b][/size]
If you have the [b]Stardew Valley Expanded Winery[/b] building on the same farm, the automation pipeline extends to include cask aging. Wine and juice produced by your kegs will automatically be sent to empty casks in the Winery, and iridium-quality products will be collected and stored back in your shed's chests.
No Winery? No problem — the shed works perfectly fine on its own. The automation will simply stop at the keg stage and store products in your chests.
[line]
[size=4][b]Building Cost[/b][/size]
Purchase from Robin's Carpenter Shop:
[list]
[*][b]750,000g[/b]
[*][b]10 Iridium Sprinklers[/b]
[*][b]200 Deluxe Speed-Gro[/b]
[*][b]10 OmniBuild[/b] — A custom crafting item. Purchase the recipe from Robin for 1,000g.
[/list]
[b]OmniBuild Recipe:[/b]
[list]
[*]10 Refined Quartz
[*]40 Stone
[*]30 Hardwood
[*]20 Wood
[/list]
[size=3][b]Total raw materials needed:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]10 Iridium Sprinklers (or 50 Gold Ore + 50 Iridium Ore + 10 Battery Packs + 20 Coal)
[*]200 Deluxe Speed-Gro
[*]100 Refined Quartz (or 100 Quartz + 100 Coal)
[*]400 Stone
[*]300 Hardwood
[*]200 Wood
[/list]
[line]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]SMAPI[/url] (latest version)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] (required — uses Grandpa's Shed maps)
[/list]
[line]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI, Content Patcher, and Stardew Valley Expanded if you haven't already.
[*]Download this mod and unzip the contents into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.
[*]You should have two new folders: [font=Courier New][CP] GrandpasPremiumShed[/font] and [font=Courier New]GrandpasPremiumShedHelper[/font].
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.
[*]Visit Robin to purchase the OmniBuild recipe, then build Grandpa's Premium Shed!
[/list]
[line]
[size=4][b]Tips[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Place at least one chest on the main floor for the automation pipeline to store items.
[*]Multiple chests are supported — if one fills up, overflow goes to the next.
[*]The building is limited to one per save file.
[*]Place your shed and Winery on the same farm location for the cask automation to connect.
[/list]
[line]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Requires Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*]Requires Stardew Valley Expanded
[*]Works in single-player
[*]Compatible with CJB Cheats Menu and other common mods
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Fixed an oversight. Items that are capable of being used by casks or kegs can be deposited inside the shed's chest by the player, and the automation will succeed. Previously, manually deposited items did not automate.
